data.source: Pinterest production API v5 public-pin metrics plus GA4 and first-party database acquisition checks
caveats: Captured about ten seconds after production publication as a receipt baseline, not a performance verdict.

The bounded format experiment currently has two Arm B headline Pins and no post-authorization Arm A control Pin; both Arm B Pins are at zero impressions, saves, Pin clicks, outbound clicks, attributable sessions, and downstream product clicks.
The full truthful public profile measured 247 impressions, two Pin clicks, one save, and zero outbound clicks; the two engagements and one save remain on the older goat Pin.
Pinterest v3 and Sandbox objects are excluded.
Revenue is unavailable from the current affiliate reporting path and remains null.
